newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Canada, Aussie miners snub Argentine province.
newsitem.headline: Canada, Aussie miners snub Argentine province.

text.p: An Argentine province is considering its options after Australia's Duketon Goldfields NL and Canada's Yukon Revenue Mines Ltd failed to show up to sign a tender contract, an official said Friday.

The two firms failed to sign the contract by the April 15 deadline after being awarded an exploration and development tender by La Rioja province, the northwestern province's mining director Juan Carlos Sacco told Reuters.
"It was a surprise. We don't know the reasons," Sacco said. "We had met representatives of the firms in Buenos Aires 15 days earlier and then we had no further contact with them."
Sacco said the companies would lose a $5,000 deposit and that the province was considering its legal options. He would not comment whether this could mean action against the firms.
Sacco added that the La Rioja government was not sure whether to call another tender for the Sierras de las Minas y Ulapes gold prospect.
Duketon and Yukon had offered to invest about $3 million exploring Sierras de las Minas y Ulapes, Sacco said. It was the only offer received in the tender called last year.
